name: Burke v. Visa, Mastercard Nonbank ATM Surcharge Settlement
summary: $167.5 million settlement (Visa $88.775M + Mastercard $78.725M) resolving antitrust claims over surcharge fees paid at independent (non-bank) ATMs in the U.S. between October 2007 and August 2026. No documentation required to file.

eligibilityQuestions.text: Did you pay a surcharge fee when withdrawing cash from an independent (non-bank) ATM between October 24, 2007 and August 14, 2026?
Was the withdrawal made in the United States using an ATM or PIN-debit card linked to a deposit account?
